label: plastic object manufacturing process
definition: A manufacturing process of a piece of synthetic plastic that has a plastic object as the main output.

label: plastic object usage process
definition: A usage process of some piece of synthetic polymer-based material where at least one of the involved pieces of synthetic polymer-based material is a plastic object employed for a purpose.

label: disposal process of a plastic object
definition: A disposal process of a piece of plastic' that applies to some plastic object deemed to be waste, resulting in its removal and demise.

label: transportation process of a plastic object
definition: A transportation process that concerns a piece of synthetic plastic.
